ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np, pandas as pd\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data\\nU=[\'000300.SH\',\'SPX\',\'HSI\',\'N225\',\'SX5E\',\'000688.SH\',\'SOX\',\'NDX\',\'XAU\',\'COPPER\',\'WTI\',\'BTC\',\'ETH\',\'US10Y\',\'CN10Y\']\\nraw={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}\\nclose=pd.DataFrame({s:(d.set_index(\'date\')[\'close\'] if d is not None else pd.Series(dtype=float)) for s,d in raw.items()}).sort_index()\\nr=np.log(close).diff()\\nbase=-(r.rolling(10).sum().sub(r.rolling(10).sum().median(axis=1),axis=0))/(r.rolling(40).std()*np.sqrt(40))\\nf=base.rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean().shift(1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)\\nprint(\'cutoff\',close.index.max().date(),\'dates\',len(close),\'assets\',len(U),\'coverage %.4f\'%(f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size))\\nrank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print(\'turnover10 %.4f\'%((rank-rank.shift(10)).abs().mean(axis=1).mean()))\\nfor h in [1,5,10,20]:\\n fr=close.shift(-h)/close-1; vals=[]\\n for dt in f.index:\\n  x=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()\\n  if len(x)>=8: vals.append((dt,x.iloc[:,0].corr(x.iloc[:,1]),len(x)))\\n z=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=[\'date\',\'ic\',\'n\']).set_index(\'date\'); m=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)\\n print(\'H%d dates=%d avgN=%.2f IC=%+.6f ICIR=%+.6f hit=%.4f\'%(h,len(z),z.n.mean(),m,m/sd,(z.ic>0).mean()))\\n if h==10:\\n  for a in np.array_split(z,3): print(\'third dates=%d IC=%+.6f\'%(len(a),a.ic.mean()))\\nf.stack().rename(\'signal\').reset_index().rename(columns={\'level_0\':\'date\',\'level_1\':\'symbol\',0:\'signal\'}).to_csv(\'scripts/miner_2_20321018_smoothed_residual_reversal_signal.csv\',index=False)\\n","file_path":"scripts/miner_2_20321018_smoothed_residual_reversal.py"}', call_id='call_OuOjq3PpBk7PZxcmNGEftj0n', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_027c54f184c4c60f016a8cdc3e7c3887d0a6fa2fefdaf81b85', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={s:pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); r=np.log(P).diff()
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].reindex(P.index).ffill()
# candidate: 10d residual reversal, 5-observation smoothing, amplified only when VIX is above trailing 60d median
cross=r.sub(r.median(axis=1),axis=0)
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()
raw=-cross.rolling(10,min_periods=10).sum()/vol
smooth=raw.rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean().shift(1)
vg=(vix > vix.rolling(60,min_periods=30).median()).astype(float)
f=smooth*(1.0+0.50*vg)
cut=pd.Timestamp('2032-10-15'); f=f.loc[:cut]
rows={h:[] for h in [1,5,10,20]}; dates=[]; cov=[]
for i,d in enumerate(f.index):
  if i+20>=len(P.index): break
  fut=P.pct_change(h).shift(-h).loc[d] if False else None
  # exact forward return from d to d+h
  try: y=P.loc[P.index[P.index.get_loc(d)+10]]/P.loc[d]-1
  except: continue
  x=f.loc[d]; z=pd.concat([x.rename('x'),y.rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
    dates.append(d); cov.append(len(z)/15)
    for h in rows:
      j=P.index.get_loc(d)+h
      if j>=len(P): continue
      yy=P.iloc[j]/P.loc[d]-1
      q=pd.concat([x.rename('x'),yy.rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
      if len(q)>=8: rows[h].append(spearmanr(q.x,q.y).statistic)
print('cutoff',cut.date(),'dates',len(dates),'avg_n',round(np.mean(np.array(cov)*15),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(cov),4))
for h,a in rows.items():
 a=np.array(a); print(h,'IC',round(np.nanmean(a),6),'ICIR',round(np.nanmean(a)/np.nanstd(a,ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4),'n',len(a),'thirds',[round(np.nanmean(x),6) for x in np.array_split(a,3)])
# turnover rank among valid names
changes=[]; prev=None
for d in dates:
 q=f.loc[d].dropna().rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None:
  ix=q.index.intersection(prev.index); changes.append(np.mean(abs(q[ix]-prev[ix])))
 prev=q
print('rank_turnover',round(np.mean(changes),6),'signal_dates',len(dates))
print('vix_high_frac',round(vg.loc[:cut].mean(),4))

arguments.content:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
base='../persistent/stock_data'
px={s:pd.read_csv(f'{base}/{s}.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'] for s in U}
P=pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index(); r=np.log(P).diff()
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')['close'].reindex(P.index).ffill()
cross=r.sub(r.median(axis=1),axis='index')
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()
raw=-cross.rolling(10,min_periods=10).sum()/vol
smooth=raw.rolling(5,min_periods=3).mean().shift(1)
vg=(vix > vix.rolling(60,min_periods=30).median()).astype(float)
f=smooth.mul(1.0+0.50*vg,axis='index')
cut=pd.Timestamp('2032-10-15'); f=f.loc[:cut]
rows={h:[] for h in [1,5,10,20]}; dates=[]; cov=[]
for d in f.index:
  x=f.loc[d]
  if x.notna().sum()<8: continue
  i=P.index.get_loc(d); dates.append(d); cov.append(x.notna().sum()/15)
  for h in rows:
   if i+h>=len(P): continue
   yy=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1
   q=pd.concat([x.rename('x'),yy.rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
   if len(q)>=8: rows[h].append(spearmanr(q.x,q.y).statistic)
print('cutoff',cut.date(),'dates',len(dates),'avg_n',round(np.mean(np.array(cov)*15),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(cov),4))
for h,a in rows.items():
 a=np.array(a); print(h,'IC',round(np.nanmean(a),6),'ICIR',round(np.nanmean(a)/np.nanstd(a,ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4),'n',len(a),'thirds',[round(np.nanmean(x),6) for x in np.array_split(a,3)])
changes=[]; prev=None
for d in dates:
 q=f.loc[d].dropna().rank(pct=True)
 if prev is not None:
  ix=q.index.intersection(prev.index); changes.append(np.mean(abs(q[ix]-prev[ix])))
 prev=q
print('rank_turnover',round(np.mean(changes),6),'vix_high_frac',round(vg.loc[:cut].mean(),4))

### Explored Candidate

Tested a **VIX-amplified five-day smoothed residual-reversal signal**:

- Base signal: negative 10-day cross-sectional residual return versus the daily cross-sectional median.
- Normalized by trailing 40-day volatility.
- Smoothed over five observations and lagged by one completed session.
- Signal magnitude increased by 50% when VIX exceeded its trailing 60-day median.
- Universe: the same 15 tradable instruments.
- Validation cutoff: **2032-10-15**.

### Validation Results

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |

Additional observations:

- Aggregate coverage: **75.44%**.
- Approximate rank-change measure: **5.81%**; this uses a different calculation from the previously reported 26.96% turnover and should not be compared directly without harmonizing definitions.
- H10 IC was positive across all chronological thirds:
  - First third: **+0.017960**
  - Second third: **+0.065854**
  - Final third: **+0.048636**
- The VIX-high condition was active on approximately **47.99%** of observations.
- The candidate clears the existing H10 admission thresholds:
  - IC: **0.044147 ≥ 0.0070**
  - ICIR: **0.145688 ≥ 0.0840**

### Historical Context

The previously admitted five-day smoothed residual-reversal factor had H10 IC **+0.037421** and ICIR **+0.123264**, with lower reported coverage of **37.60%**. The VIX-amplified variant improves the measured H10 results and coverage while retaining positive performance throughout the historical thirds. Interpretation remains conservative because the cross-section contains only 15 instruments and the condition may introduce regime dependence.

- `scripts/miner_2_20321101_vix_amplified_smoothed_residual_signal.csv`

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index() for s in U}
cut=pd.Timestamp('2032-11-14'); P=pd.DataFrame({s:D[s].close for s in U}); lr=np.log(P).diff()
# One idea: 5-day reversal scaled by lagged 20-day true range, cross-sectional demeaned.
# Range uses only bars through t and signal is lagged by one completed session.
rets={h:[] for h in [1,5,10,20]}; dates={h:[] for h in rets}; ns={h:[] for h in rets}; turns=[]; prev=None; rows=[]
for i,t in enumerate(P.index[P.index<=cut]):
 if i<25: continue
 past=P.index[P.index<=t]
 # signal at t based on t-1 data
 if len(past)<27: continue
 end=past[-2]; hist=P.index[P.index<=end]
 r5=lr.loc[:end].tail(5).sum()
 ranges=[]
 for s in U:
  x=D[s].loc[:end].tail(20)
  ranges.append((s, ((x.high-x.low)/x.close).mean()))
 atr=pd.Series(dict(ranges)); sig=(-r5/atr).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna(); sig=sig-sig.median()
 rank=sig.rank(pct=True); turns.append(0 if prev is None else (rank-prev.reindex(rank.index).fillna(.5)).abs().mean()); prev=rank
 for h in rets:
  yy={}
  for s in sig.index:
   fut=D[s].loc[D[s].index>t].close
   if len(fut)>=h: yy[s]=fut.iloc[h-1]/P.loc[t,s]-1
  com=list(set(sig.index)&set(yy));
  if len(com)>=8:

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2032-11-15

### Explored Factors

1. **Range-normalized 5-day reversal**
   - Signal: negative 5-day return divided by the asset’s lagged 20-day average high-low range, cross-sectionally demeaned.
   - Intended to identify short-term mean reversion after unusually large moves while accounting for asset-specific trading ranges.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Signal artifact generated at:
     `scripts/miner_2_20321115_range_norm_reversal_signal.csv`

2. **Beta-neutral residual reversal**
   - Signal: negative 5-day return residual after removing rolling 60-day beta exposure to the equal-weight universe return, scaled by 30-day volatility.
   - Intended to isolate asset-specific shocks rather than broad market moves.
   - Signal artifact generated at:
     `scripts/miner_2_20321115_beta_resid_reversal_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

#### Range-normalized reversal

Validation through 2032-11-14:

| Horizon | Dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 day | 4,014 | 12.0 | 0.006424 | 0.018550 |
| 5 days | 4,014 | 12.0 | 0.006968 | 0.019985 |
| 10 days | 4,014 | 12.0 | 0.000583 | 0.001703 |
| 20 days | 4,014 | 12.0 | 0.011204 | 0.032827 |

Average rank turnover was 0.151978. The 20-day IC exceeded the 0.007 absolute IC threshold, but ICIR was far below the required 0.0840 threshold. The factor therefore failed admission.

#### Beta-neutral residual reversal

Validation through 2032-11-14:

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | IC | ICIR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 day | 3,292 | 13.46 | 0.005587 | 0.017649 |
| 5 days | 3,292 | 13.46 | 0.003655 | 0.011409 |
| 10 days | 3,292 | 13.46 | 0.000622 | 0.001980 |
| 20 days | 3,292 | 13.46 | 0.004337 | 0.013640 |

Average coverage at the 10-day horizon was approximately 89.76%, with average rank turnover of 0.154184. The factor failed both the IC and ICIR admission requirements.

### Persistence Actions

- No factors persisted.
- No candidate met both benchmark admission gates:
  - absolute daily paper IC ≥ 0.0070
  - absolute daily paper ICIR ≥ 0.0840

### Current Effective Factors

No changes were made to the existing effective-factor library. Existing effective factors remain subject to their prior validation records and periodic revalidation.

### Plans

- Investigate lower-turnover multi-horizon reversal signals combining residual returns with breadth or recovery-efficiency conditions.
- Test conditional versions activated only during elevated cross-asset dispersion or volatility regimes.
- Continue using conservative interpretation because the cross-section contains only 15 instruments, despite the large number of historical dates.

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2032-12-13

2. **Downside-risk-adjusted medium-term reversal**
   - Signal:  
     \[
     -\frac{r_{10d}}{\sigma_{\text{downside},40d}}
     \]
   - Fully lagged and cross-sectionally evaluated across the same 15 instruments.
   - Motivation: identify oversold assets whose prior returns were large relative to downside volatility.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20321213_downside_adj_reversal_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

Validation used approximately 4,005 daily cross-sectional observations, with an average of 13.46 valid instruments per date and approximately 89.77% coverage. The results below use daily cross-sectional Spearman IC observations.

| Factor | Horizon | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Downside-adjusted momentum | 1d | -0.006600 | -0.020727 | 36.85% | Failed |

|  | 10d | +0.008511 | +0.026651 | 38.68% | Failed |
|  | 20d | +0.008648 | +0.027592 | 39.33% | Failed |

The reversal variant exceeded the absolute daily IC threshold at 5d, 10d, and 20d, but none of its ICIR values approached the required **0.0840** gate. The momentum variant failed both the IC and ICIR requirements.

Regime diagnostics for the reversal variant were mixed:

- H10 chronological thirds: **-0.025796, -0.025226, +0.051627**

import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p='../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'
 if os.path.exists(p):
  x=pd.read_csv(p); x['date']=pd.to_datetime(x.date); D[s]=x.set_index('date').close
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index(); rets=px.pct_change()
# candidate: residual 5d reversal, normalized by downside vol, only when broad cross-asset dispersion is elevated
r5=px.pct_change(5); resid=r5.sub(r5.median(axis=1),axis=0)
down=rets.where(rets<0).rolling(30,min_periods=15).std()
base=-resid/(down+1e-8)
disp=rets.std(axis=1).rolling(60,min_periods=30).mean()
gate=(disp>disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).median()).astype(float)
f=base.mul(gate,axis=0).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
# avoid all zeros on inactive dates by mark nan
f[gate==0]=np.nan
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fr=px.shift(-h)/px-1
 vals=[]; ns=[]; dates=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a=f.loc[dt]; b=fr.loc[dt]
  z=pd.concat([a,b],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   vals.append(spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic); ns.append(len(z)); dates.append(dt)
 v=np.array(vals); print('H',h,'dates',len(v),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(np.nanmean(v),np.nanmean(v)/(np.nanstd(v,ddof=1)+1e-12),np.mean(v>0)))
# turnover among active dates
rr=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); active=rr.dropna(how='all'); print('active_dates',len(active),'coverage',np.mean([f.loc[x].notna().sum()/15 for x in f.index]),'turnover',np.nanmean((active-active.shift()).abs().mean(axis=1)))
# thirds H10
h=10; fr=px.shift(-h)/px-1; vals=[]
for dt in f.index:
 z=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: vals.append((dt,spearmanr(z.iloc[:,0],z.iloc[:,1]).statistic))
v=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['d','ic']); print('thirds',v.groupby(pd.qcut(np.arange(len(v)),3,labels=False)).ic.mean().to_list())
out=f.reset_index().melt(id_vars='date',var_name='symbol',value_name='signal'); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20321227_dispersion_downside_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle — 2032-12-27

### Historical Context

- The 2032-12-13 downside-adjusted momentum and reversal candidates both failed admission:
  - Reversal showed modest positive IC, but ICIR remained far below the **0.0840** gate.
  - No factors were persisted.
- The existing dispersion-gated residual-reversal factor remains effective, with previously reported 20-day IC **0.057212** and ICIR **0.176498**.
- The eight-factor ensemble was retained and synchronized on 2032-12-27. Its live block from **2032-12-13 to 2032-12-27** returned **+2.04%**, Sharpe **6.04**, and max drawdown **0.74%**. Attribution and explicit turnover/slippage remain unavailable.

### Explored Factors

1. **Dispersion-gated downside-volatility residual reversal**
   - Five-day asset return residualized against the cross-sectional median.
   - Reversed and divided by 30-day downside volatility.
   - Active only during elevated cross-asset dispersion.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20321227_dispersion_downside_reversal_signal.csv`

2. **One-day volatility-normalized reversal**
   - Negative one-day return divided by 20-day volatility.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20321227_1d_vol_reversal_signal.csv`

3. **Five-day residual reversal normalized by 40-day volatility**
   - Five-day return relative to the cross-sectional median, reversed and volatility-scaled.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20321227_residual5_vol40_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Dispersion-gated downside residual reversal | 1d | +0.008697 | +0.022996 | 48.50% | Failed |
|  | 5d | -0.024333 | -0.064982 | 47.41% | Failed |
|  | 10d | -0.039189 | -0.103878 | 44.41% | Failed |
|  | 20d | -0.025231 | -0.065351 | 46.87% | Failed |
| One-day volatility-normalized reversal | 1d | +0.022021 | +0.068482 | 51.93% | Failed |
|  | 5d | +0.013956 | +0.043707 | 51.24% | Failed |
|  | 10d | +0.009234 | +0.029867 | 51.41% | Failed |
|  | 20d | +0.008702 | +0.027118 | 51.56% | Failed |
| Five-day residual reversal / 40d volatility | 1d | +0.022239 | +0.069417 | 52.87% | Failed |
|  | 5d | -0.002475 | -0.007970 | 50.00% | Failed |
|  | 10d | +0.014083 | +0.044922 | 50.83% | Failed |
|  | 20d | +0.020667 | +0.065136 | 53.41% | Failed |

The one-day volatility-normalized reversal and five-day residual reversal produced the strongest results, but neither met the **0.0840 ICIR** admission gate. The dispersion-gated candidate was clearly unsuccessful, with negative multi-day ICs and poor stability.

Coverage and rank turnover were also mixed:

- One-day volatility-normalized reversal: approximately **77.4% coverage**, **0.3118** rank turnover.
- Five-day residual reversal / 40-day volatility: approximately **71.1% coverage**, **0.1758** rank turnover.
- Dispersion-gated candidate: only approximately **12.3% effective coverage** and **0.1434** turnover; its H10 chronological-thirds ICs were **-0.0979, -0.0140, -0.0052**, showing persistent weakness.

### Persistence Actions

- **No new factors persisted.**
- All three candidates failed the benchmark admission criteria.
- No new factor files were written to `factors/`.

### Plans

- Retain the current eight-factor ensemble and monitor whether the recent rebound persists.
- Continue testing residual-reversal variants, but avoid overly restrictive dispersion gates that materially reduce coverage.
- Investigate lower-turnover volatility-normalized reversal specifications and alternative lookback/skip structures.
- Revalidate the existing dispersion-gated effective factor on schedule.

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np,pandas as pd\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data\\nU=[\'000300.SH\',\'SPX\',\'HSI\',\'N225\',\'SX5E\',\'000688.SH\',\'SOX\',\'NDX\',\'XAU\',\'COPPER\',\'WTI\',\'BTC\',\'ETH\',\'US10Y\',\'CN10Y\']\\nD={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}\\nC=pd.DataFrame({s:(d.set_index(\'date\').close if d is not None else pd.Series(dtype=float)) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index(); R=C.pct_change()\\n# medium-horizon cross-sectional residual reversal, skip two sessions, risk scaled\\nm=R.rolling(10).sum(); resid=m.sub(m.median(axis=1),axis=0); v=R.rolling(40).std()*np.sqrt(40)\\nf=(-resid/v).shift(2).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)\\nrows=[]\\nfor h in [1,5,10,20]:\\n F=C.shift(-h)/C-1; z=[]\\n for t in f.index:\\n  q=pd.concat([f.loc[t],F.loc[t]],axis=1).dropna()\\n  if len(q)>=8:z.append((t,q.iloc[:,0].corr(q.iloc[:,1]),len(q)))\\n z=pd.DataFrame(z,columns=[\'date\',\'ic\',\'n\']).set_index(\'date\'); mu=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)\\n print(\'H%d dates=%d avgN=%.2f IC=%+.6f ICIR=%+.6f hit=%.4f\'%(h,len(z),z.n.mean(),mu,mu/sd*np.sqrt(252), (z.ic>0).mean()))\\n if h==10:\\n  for a in np.array_split(z,3):print(\'third\',len(a),a.ic.mean())\\nprint(\'cutoff\',C.index.max(),\'assets\',len(U),\'coverage\',f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,\'turnover10\',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff(10).abs().mean(axis=1).mean())\\nf.stack().rename(\'signal\').rename_axis([\'date\',\'symbol\']).reset_index().to_csv(\'scripts/miner_2_20330110_medium_residual_reversal_signal.csv\',index=False)\\n","file_path":"scripts/miner_2_20330110_medium_residual_reversal.py"}', call_id='call_W9hmGI8vmsgUPUtuh73v9bTh', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_0d2b77953ad674f9016a8cee34d85887d0ab3ab4fcfa9a65d0', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}
C=pd.DataFrame({s:(d.set_index('date').close if d is not None else pd.Series(dtype=float)) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index()
R=C.pct_change()
# Shock-recovery: residual 5-day selloff, normalized by downside volatility,
# activated only when prior cross-sectional dispersion is elevated. Two-day lag.
short=R.rolling(5).sum(); resid=short.sub(short.median(axis=1),axis=0)
down=R.where(R<0).rolling(30).std().replace(0,np.nan)
disp=R.rolling(5).std(axis=1)
threshold=disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(.65)
gate=(disp>threshold).astype(float).replace(0,np.nan)
f=(-resid/down*gate).shift(2).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
rows=[]
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
    F=C.shift(-h)/C-1; vals=[]
    for t in f.index:
        q=pd.concat([f.loc[t],F.loc[t]],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(q)>=8: vals.append((t,q.iloc[:,0].corr(q.iloc[:,1]),len(q)))
    z=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date')
    mu=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)
    print(f'H{h} dates={len(z)} avgN={z.n.mean():.2f} IC={mu:+.6f} ICIR={mu/sd*np.sqrt(252):+.6f} hit={(z.ic>0).mean():.4f}')
    if h==10:
        for i,a in enumerate(np.array_split(z,3)): print(f'third{i+1} dates={len(a)} IC={a.ic.mean():+.6f}')
print('cutoff',C.index.max(),'assets',len(U),'coverage',f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,'active_dates',gate.notna().sum())
print('turnover10',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff(10).abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
f.stack().rename('signal').rename_axis(['date','symbol']).reset_index().to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330124_shock_recovery_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}
C=pd.DataFrame({s:(d.set_index('date').close if d is not None else pd.Series(dtype=float)) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index(); R=C.pct_change()
short=R.rolling(5).sum(); resid=short.sub(short.median(axis=1),axis=0)
down=R.where(R<0).rolling(30).std().replace(0,np.nan); disp=R.std(axis=1).rolling(5).mean()
threshold=disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(.65); gate=(disp>threshold).astype(float).replace(0,np.nan)
f=(-resid/down*gate).shift(2).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 F=C.shift(-h)/C-1; vals=[]
 for t in f.index:
  q=pd.concat([f.loc[t],F.loc[t]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8: vals.append((t,q.iloc[:,0].corr(q.iloc[:,1]),len(q)))
 z=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); mu=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print(f'H{h} dates={len(z)} avgN={z.n.mean():.2f} IC={mu:+.6f} ICIR={mu/sd*np.sqrt(252):+.6f} hit={(z.ic>0).mean():.4f}')
 if h==10:
  for i,a in enumerate(np.array_split(z.index,3)): print(f'third{i+1} dates={len(a)} IC={z.loc[a,"ic"].mean():+.6f}')
print('cutoff',C.index.max(),'assets',len(U),'coverage',f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,'active_dates',gate.notna().sum())
print('turnover10',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff(10).abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
f.stack().rename('signal').rename_axis(['date','symbol']).reset_index().to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330124_shock_recovery_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={s:get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000) for s in U}
C=pd.DataFrame({s:(d.set_index('date').close if d is not None else pd.Series(dtype=float)) for s,d in D.items()}).sort_index(); R=C.pct_change()
short=R.rolling(5).sum(); resid=short.sub(short.median(axis=1),axis=0)
vol=R.rolling(30,min_periods=8).std().replace(0,np.nan); disp=R.std(axis=1).rolling(5).mean()
threshold=disp.rolling(120,min_periods=60).quantile(.65); gate=(disp>threshold).astype(float).replace(0,np.nan)
f=(-resid/vol*gate).shift(2).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 F=C.shift(-h)/C-1; vals=[]
 for t in f.index:
  q=pd.concat([f.loc[t],F.loc[t]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8: vals.append((t,q.iloc[:,0].corr(q.iloc[:,1]),len(q)))
 z=pd.DataFrame(vals,columns=['date','ic','n']).set_index('date'); mu=z.ic.mean(); sd=z.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print(f'H{h} dates={len(z)} avgN={z.n.mean():.2f} IC={mu:+.6f} ICIR={mu/sd*np.sqrt(252):+.6f} hit={(z.ic>0).mean():.4f}')
 if h==10:
  for i,a in enumerate(np.array_split(z.index,3)): print(f'third{i+1} dates={len(a)} IC={z.loc[a,"ic"].mean():+.6f}')
print('cutoff',C.index.max(),'assets',len(U),'coverage',f.notna().sum().sum()/f.size,'active_dates',gate.notna().sum())
print('turnover10',f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff(10).abs().mean(axis=1).mean())
f.stack().rename('signal').rename_axis(['date','symbol']).reset_index().to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330124_shock_recovery_signal.csv',index=False)

- Revalidate the current effective delayed-reversal factor as it approaches its monitoring interval.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 x=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000)
 if x is not None and len(x)>100:
  z=x[['date','close']].copy(); z.date=pd.to_datetime(z.date); D[s]=z.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
base=-(p.pct_change(10).shift(10))/r.rolling(40).std().shift(10)
# Stress-conditioned delayed reversal. Breadth is measured only through the
# same lagged endpoint; amplify reversal during broad weakness, retain 25%
# exposure otherwise to avoid discontinuities.
ret20=p.pct_change(20).shift(10)
breadth=(ret20>0).sum(axis=1)/ret20.notna().sum(axis=1)
gate=np.where(breadth<0.40,1.0,0.25)
f=base.mul(pd.Series(gate,index=p.index),axis=0)
print('cutoff',p.index.max().date(),'calendar_dates',len(p),'assets',len(D),'avg_valid=%.2f'%f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fr=p.pct_change(h).shift(-h); vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1])); ns.append(len(a))
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print('H%d dates=%d avgN=%.2f IC=%+.6f ICIR=%+.6f hit=%.4f'%(h,len(q),np.mean(ns),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==10: print('H10 thirds',*[round(x.mean(),6) for x in np.array_split(q,3)])
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); ch=(rank.diff().abs().sum(axis=1)/rank.notna().sum(axis=1)).dropna()
print('coverage=%.4f turnover=%.4f stress_frac=%.4f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),ch.mean(),(breadth<.4).mean()))
out=f.copy(); out.index.name='date'; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330307_stress_gated_skip10_reversal_signal.csv')
print('artifact=scripts/miner_2_20330307_stress_gated_skip10_reversal_signal.csv')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 x=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000)
 if x is not None and len(x)>100:
  z=x[['date','close']].copy(); z.date=pd.to_datetime(z.date); D[s]=z.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
base=-(p.pct_change(10).shift(10))/r.rolling(40).std().shift(10)
# Relative delayed reversal: emphasize assets whose lagged 20d return is below
# the contemporaneous cross-sectional median; all inputs are lagged.
rr=p.pct_change(20).shift(10)
med=rr.median(axis=1)
rel=rr.sub(med,axis=0)
gate=1.0+0.50*np.tanh(-rel/0.10)
f=base*gate
print('cutoff',p.index.max().date(),'calendar_dates',len(p),'assets',len(D),'avg_valid=%.2f'%f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fr=p.pct_change(h).shift(-h); vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1])); ns.append(len(a))
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print('H%d dates=%d avgN=%.2f IC=%+.6f ICIR=%+.6f hit=%.4f'%(h,len(q),np.mean(ns),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==10: print('H10 thirds',*[round(x.mean(),6) for x in np.array_split(q,3)])
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); ch=(rank.diff().abs().sum(axis=1)/rank.notna().sum(axis=1)).dropna()
print('coverage=%.4f turnover=%.4f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),ch.mean()))
out=f.copy(); out.index.name='date'; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330307_relative_gated_skip10_reversal_signal.csv')
print('artifact=scripts/miner_2_20330307_relative_gated_skip10_reversal_signal.csv')

final_state.output_text:
### Explored Factors

1. **Stress-gated delayed volatility-normalized reversal**
   - Signal: negative 10-session return, delayed by 10 completed sessions, divided by 40-session realized volatility.
   - Conditioning: full signal during broad lagged weakness, defined as fewer than 40% of assets positive over lagged 20-day returns; otherwise scaled to 25%.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20330307_stress_gated_skip10_reversal_signal.csv`

2. **Relative breadth-adjusted delayed reversal**
   - Signal: existing delayed reversal scaled according to each asset’s lagged 20-day return relative to the cross-sectional median.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20330307_relative_gated_skip10_reversal_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

Validation cutoff: **2033-03-04**  
Validation date: **2033-03-07**  
Universe: **15 assets**, with at least 8 valid instruments per IC observation.

| Factor | H10 observations | H10 IC | H10 ICIR | Coverage | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Stress-gated delayed reversal | 1,675 | +0.049113 | +0.161606 | 38.35% | 8.75% | **Passed** |
| Relative breadth-adjusted reversal | 1,675 | +0.044739 | +0.145995 | 38.35% | 9.70% | **Passed** |

Both candidates exceeded the benchmark admission gates of absolute IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840**.

For the stress-gated factor:

- H1 IC / ICIR: +0.020778 / +0.067110
- H5 IC / ICIR: +0.048037 / +0.160404
- H10 IC / ICIR: +0.049113 / +0.161606
- H20 IC / ICIR: +0.039554 / +0.128292
- H10 chronological-third ICs: +0.067705, +0.033884, +0.045717
- H10 hit ratio: 56.30%
- Average valid cross-section: 11.23 instruments
- Stress regime frequency: 37.35%

The stress-gated variant was selected because it had higher H10 IC and ICIR, lower turnover, and stronger consistency than the relative breadth-adjusted alternative.

### Persistence Actions

Persisted and reload-verified:

- `factors/miner_2_20330307_stress_gated_skip10_reversal.json`
  - Status: **EFFECTIVE**
  - Signal artifact recorded
  - Validation metrics and timestamp recorded
  - `max_abs_library_correlation`: `null` pending deterministic library recomputation

The relative breadth-adjusted candidate was not persisted despite passing the standalone gate because it is closely related to the existing delayed-reversal library and had weaker standalone performance.

### Current Effective Factors

- Existing delayed 10-day volatility-normalized reversal:
  - H10 IC: +0.049160
  - H10 ICIR: +0.161592
  - Last validated: 2033-02-07
- Newly persisted stress-gated delayed volatility-normalized reversal:
  - H10 IC: +0.049113
  - H10 ICIR: +0.161606
  - Validated: 2033-03-07

### Plans

- Reassess pairwise correlation against the complete factor library when deterministic signal comparison is available.
- Revalidate both effective delayed-reversal factors within the next monitoring interval.
- Explore less-overlapping cross-asset dispersion and macro-regime residual factors.
- Continue prioritizing recent chronological stability and low-turnover variants.

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 x=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=5000)
 if x is not None and len(x)>100:
  z=x[['date','close']].copy(); z.date=pd.to_datetime(z.date); D[s]=z.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index(); r=p.pct_change()
# Delayed volatility-regime breakout: recent 20d momentum, normalized by
# 40d volatility, and emphasized when volatility is contracting versus its
# 120d baseline. Every input is shifted 10 sessions before scoring.
vol40=r.rolling(40).std(); vol120=r.rolling(120).std()
raw=p.pct_change(20)/vol40 * (vol120/vol40).clip(0.5,2.0)
f=raw.shift(10)
print('cutoff',p.index.max().date(),'calendar_dates',len(p),'assets',len(D),'avg_valid=%.2f'%f.notna().sum(axis=1).mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fr=p.pct_change(h).shift(-h); vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in f.index:
  a=pd.concat([f.loc[dt],fr.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(a)>=8: vals.append(a.iloc[:,0].corr(a.iloc[:,1])); ns.append(len(a))
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print('H%d dates=%d avgN=%.2f IC=%+.6f ICIR=%+.6f hit=%.4f'%(h,len(q),np.mean(ns),q.mean(),q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),(q>0).mean()))
 if h==10: print('H10 thirds',*[round(x.mean(),6) for x in np.array_split(q,3)])
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); ch=(rank.diff().abs().sum(axis=1)/rank.notna().sum(axis=1)).dropna()
print('coverage=%.4f turnover=%.4f'%(f.notna().mean().mean(),ch.mean()))
out=f.copy(); out.index.name='date'; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330321_volregime_breakout_signal.csv')
print('artifact=scripts/miner_2_20330321_volregime_breakout_signal.csv')

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_account_dict, get_index_daily_data, get_stock_daily_data

acct=get_account_dict(); syms=acct.get('watch_list',[])
if not syms: syms=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
prices={}
for s in syms:
    d=get_stock_daily_data(s, 5000)
    if d is None or len(d)<100: d=get_index_daily_data(s,5000)
    if d is not None and len(d): prices[s]=d.set_index(pd.to_datetime(d.date)).close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(prices).sort_index().ffill()
# skip-5 medium reversal: negative return over t-25 to t-5, scaled by 40d realized vol
ret=px.pct_change()
vol=ret.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(20)
factor=-(px.shift(5)/px.shift(25)-1)/vol
# lagged availability is naturally signal at t, forward begins t+1
for h in [1,5,10,20,30]:
    fr=px.shift(-h)/px-1
    vals=[]; dates=[]
    for dt in factor.index:
        x=factor.loc[dt]; y=fr.loc[dt]; z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8:
            vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')); dates.append(dt)
    a=np.asarray(vals,float); a=a[np.isfinite(a)]
    ic=a.mean(); ir=ic/a.std(ddof=1) if len(a)>1 else np.nan
    thirds=[np.mean(q) for q in np.array_split(a,3)]
    print(f'H{h} IC {ic:.6f} ICIR {ir:.6f} hit {np.mean(a>0):.4f} dates {len(a)} thirds {[round(x,6) for x in thirds]}')
valid=factor.notna().sum(axis=1); print('assets',len(syms),'dates',len(px),'avg coverage',round((valid/len(syms)).mean(),4),'latest',px.index[-1].date())
# average daily rank signal turnover proxy
r=factor.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round(r.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).mean(),4))
# save artifact
out=factor.stack().rename('signal').reset_index(); out.columns=['date','symbol','signal']; out.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330516_skip5_medium_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

### Explored Factors

1. **Skip-five-day medium-horizon volatility-normalized reversal**
   - Signal: negative 20-session return measured from \(t-25\) to \(t-5\), divided by 40-session realized volatility scaled by \(\sqrt{20}\).
   - Motivation: test whether medium-term losers, after a five-session information delay, mean-revert over longer horizons.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20330516_skip5_medium_reversal_signal.csv`

2. **Downside-risk-adjusted recovery efficiency**
   - Signal: 10-session return divided by 30-session downside deviation.
   - Motivation: identify assets recovering efficiently relative to their recent downside risk.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20330516_recovery_efficiency_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

Validation date: **2033-05-16**  
Data through the latest available completed session: **2033-05-13**  
Universe: **15 assets**, with at least 8 valid instruments required per IC date.

#### Skip-five-day medium-horizon reversal

| Horizon | IC | ICIR | Hit Ratio | Valid Dates |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| H1 | 0.002325 | 0.007258 | 50.10% | 4,138 |
| H5 | -0.010797 | -0.034321 | 47.90% | 4,134 |
| H10 | -0.017022 | -0.054958 | 47.69% | 4,129 |
| H20 | -0.019925 | -0.061005 | 48.97% | 4,119 |
| H30 | -0.006860 | -0.020536 | 49.21% | 4,109 |

- Average factor coverage: **88.72%**
- Rank turnover proxy: **0.0826**
- Chronological-third ICs at H20: **-0.038956, -0.045741, 0.024923**
- Result: **Failed admission**. No horizon met both \(|IC| \ge 0.0070\) and \(|ICIR| \ge 0.0840\). The factor was also unstable, with negative performance in the first two chronological thirds and a positive final third.

#### Downside-risk-adjusted recovery efficiency

| Horizon | IC | ICIR | Hit Ratio | Valid Dates |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| H1 | -0.016029 | -0.051424 | 48.11% | 4,145 |
| H5 | -0.012190 | -0.037958 | 47.31% | 4,141 |
| H10 | -0.006365 | -0.019997 | 48.14% | 4,136 |
| H20 | 0.000573 | 0.001771 | 48.62% | 4,126 |

- Average factor coverage: **99.42%**
- Rank turnover proxy: **0.0913**
- Chronological-third H1 ICs: **-0.023880, -0.012109, -0.012097**
- Result: **Failed admission**. The signal showed consistently negative short-horizon predictive power, but neither the magnitude nor ICIR met the absolute admission thresholds. It should not be persisted as effective.

### Persistence Actions

- No new factors persisted.
- No existing factor records modified.
- Both research artifacts were retained for provenance and potential future diagnostic work.

### Current Effective Factors

Based on the preceding cycle and latest available validation records:

- **Skip-five-day volatility-normalized reversal**
  - H20 IC: **0.032532**
  - H20 ICIR: **0.105752**
  - Coverage: **99.10%**
  - Turnover: **0.1431**
  - Last validated: **2033-05-02**
  - Status: **EFFECTIVE**, subject to library-correlation checks and rolling revalidation.

- **Downside-risk-adjusted medium momentum**
  - H10 IC: **-0.056245**
  - H10 ICIR: **-0.194073**
  - Coverage: **97.67%**
  - Last validated: **2033-04-18**
  - Direction: **inverse use**, pending ongoing drift monitoring.

### Plans

- Revalidate the effective skip-five-day reversal on a recent rolling three-month window.
- Investigate whether its recent deterioration is explained by volatility or macro-regime conditioning.
- Avoid persisting the tested medium reversal and recovery-efficiency variants without materially improved ICIR.
- Explore lower-overlap residual or dispersion-conditioned signals, with particular attention to regime stability across the 15-asset universe.

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os\\nA=[\'000300.SH\',\'SPX\',\'HSI\',\'N225\',\'SX5E\',\'000688.SH\',\'SOX\',\'NDX\',\'XAU\',\'COPPER\',\'WTI\',\'BTC\',\'ETH\',\'US10Y\',\'CN10Y\']\\nstart=pd.Timestamp(\'2026-07-16\'); end=pd.Timestamp(\'2033-05-30\'); D={}\\nfor a in A:\\n p=\'../persistent/stock_data/\'+a+\'.csv\'\\n if os.path.exists(p):\\n  x=pd.read_csv(p); x.date=pd.to_datetime(x.date); D[a]=x.set_index(\'date\').close.astype(float)\\npx=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().loc[start:end]; r=px.pct_change()\\n# Compression-conditioned breakout: lagged 20d risk-adjusted trend, amplified when recent volatility is compressed.\\nvol20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); vol60=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()\\ncompression=(vol20/vol60).clip(0.4,2.5)\\nsig=((px/px.shift(20)-1)/(vol20*np.sqrt(20))).div(compression).shift(1)\\nresults={}\\nfor h in [1,5,10,20,30]:\\n f=px.shift(-h)/px-1; vals=[]; ns=[]\\n for dt in px.index:\\n  q=pd.concat([sig.loc[dt],f.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()\\n  if len(q)>=8:\\n   v=q.iloc[:,0].corr(q.iloc[:,1],method=\'spearman\')\\n   if np.isfinite(v): vals.append(v); ns.append(len(q))\\n a=np.array(vals); results[h]=a\\n print(\'H%d dates=%d avgN=%.2f IC=%+.6f ICIR=%+.6f hit=%.4f thirds=%s\'%(h,len(a),np.mean(ns),np.mean(a),np.mean(a)/(np.std(a,ddof=1)+1e-12),np.mean(a>0),[round(np.mean(z),6) for z in np.array_split(a,3)]))\\na=results[10]\\nprint(\'coverage=%.4f turnover=%.4f n_assets=%d n_dates=%d\'%(sig.notna().mean().mean(),(sig.rank(axis=1).diff().abs().stack()/15).mean(),len(D),len(px)))\\nsig.to_csv(\'scripts/miner_2_20330530_compression_breakout_signal.csv\')\\n","file_path":"scripts/miner_2_20330530_compression_breakout.py"}', call_id='call_K3gPSg8iNg7b12YUFv1qtwU0', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_092dc82e5fff96a4016a8d0a5f71c487d099d0a883c9464da8', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2033-06-12')
frames={}
for a in assets:
    p='../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv'
    d=pd.read_csv(p,parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date')
    d=d.loc[:cut]
    # robust close location, with zero-range neutral
    rng=(d.high-d.low).replace(0,np.nan)
    clv=((d.close-d.low)/rng-0.5).fillna(0)
    # factor: persistent close-location pressure, lagged one day
    d['fac']=clv.rolling(5,min_periods=4).mean().shift(1)
    d['fwd10']=d.close.shift(-10)/d.close-1
    frames[a]=d[['fac','fwd10']]
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in frames.values()]))
ics=[]; ns=[]; vals=[]
for dt in idx:
    z=pd.DataFrame({a:frames[a].loc[dt] if dt in frames[a].index else [np.nan,np.nan] for a in assets},index=['fac','fwd10']).T.dropna()
    if len(z)>=8:
        ic=z.fac.corr(z.fwd10,method='spearman')
        if pd.notna(ic): ics.append(ic);ns.append(len(z)); vals.append((dt,ic,len(z)))
ics=np.array(ics)
print('cutoff',cut.date(),'dates',len(ics),'assets',len(assets),'avgN',np.mean(ns),'coverage',np.mean(ns)/15)
print('H10 IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(ics.mean(),ics.mean()/ics.std(ddof=1),np.mean(ics>0)))
for j,part in enumerate(np.array_split(ics,3)): print('third',j+1,'n',len(part),'ic',part.mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
    arr=[]; nn=[]
    for a in assets:
      d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date').loc[:cut]
      rng=(d.high-d.low).replace(0,np.nan); clv=((d.close-d.low)/rng-.5).fillna(0)
      fac=clv.rolling(5,min_periods=4).mean().shift(1); fw=d.close.shift(-h)/d.close-1
      frames[a]=pd.DataFrame({'fac':fac,'fw':fw})
    for dt in idx:
      z=pd.DataFrame({a:frames[a].loc[dt] if dt in frames[a].index else [np.nan,np.nan] for a in assets},index=['fac','fw']).T.dropna()
      if len(z)>=8:
       q=z.fac.corr(z.fw,method='spearman')
       if pd.notna(q): arr.append(q)
    arr=np.array(arr); print('H',h,'n',len(arr),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f'%(arr.mean(),arr.mean()/arr.std(ddof=1)))
# artifact signal latest all dates
out=[]
for a,d in frames.items():
 for dt,row in d.iterrows(): out.append({'date':dt.date(),'asset':a,'signal':row.fac})
pd.DataFrame(out).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330613_clv_pressure_signal.csv',index=False)

   - Motivation: test whether persistent closing strength or weakness predicts forward cross-asset returns.

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import pandas as pd,numpy as np\\nassets=[\'000300.SH\',\'SPX\',\'HSI\',\'N225\',\'SX5E\',\'000688.SH\',\'SOX\',\'NDX\',\'XAU\',\'COPPER\',\'WTI\',\'BTC\',\'ETH\',\'US10Y\',\'CN10Y\']\\ncut=pd.Timestamp(\'2033-06-26\'); prices={}\\nfor a in assets:\\n d=pd.read_csv(\'../persistent/stock_data/\'+a+\'.csv\',parse_dates=[\'date\']).sort_values(\'date\').set_index(\'date\').loc[:cut]\\n prices[a]=d[\'close\']\\nP=pd.DataFrame(prices); r=P.pct_change()\\n# Short impulse normalized by recent risk, gated by agreement with medium trend.\\nvol=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std(); short=P.pct_change(10); medium=P.pct_change(40)\\nfac=(short/(vol*np.sqrt(30))).where(np.sign(short)==np.sign(medium),0.0).shift(1)\\nprint(\'dates\',len(fac),\'assets\',len(assets),\'coverage\',fac.notna().mean().mean())\\nfor h in [1,5,10,20]:\\n fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; vals=[]; ns=[]\\n for dt in fac.index:\\n  z=pd.concat([fac.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()\\n  if len(z)>=8:\\n   q=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method=\'spearman\')\\n   if pd.notna(q): vals.append(q); ns.append(len(z))\\n x=np.array(vals); thirds=np.array_split(x,3)\\n print(\'H\',h,\'n\',len(x),\'avgN %.2f\'%np.mean(ns),\'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f thirds\'% (x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),np.mean(x>0)),[round(y.mean(),6) for y in thirds])\\n# turnover based on rank ordering changes between dates\\nrank=fac.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print(\'turnover\',rank.diff().abs().mean().mean())\\nout=[]\\nfor dt in fac.index:\\n for a in assets: out.append({\'date\':dt.date(),\'asset\':a,\'signal\':fac.loc[dt,a]})\\npd.DataFrame(out).to_csv(\'scripts/miner_2_20330627_regime_trend_impulse_signal.csv\',index=False)\\n","file_path":"scripts/miner_2_20330627_regime_trend_impulse.py"}', call_id='call_NQkTxFLtnEfbZp1gQFYI6LKS', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_05eb4f505db39c60016a8d0fa63bdc87d0be6e6f2b85cab099', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2033-07-24'); P={}
for a in assets:
 d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date').loc[:cut]
 P[a]=d.close
P=pd.DataFrame(P); r=P.pct_change(); v20=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); v60=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()
shock=(v20/v60).clip(lower=0.5,upper=3.0)
# Contrarian 5-session return, risk-normalized and amplified only when recent volatility exceeds its 60d baseline; lag one day.
fac=((-P.pct_change(5)/(v20*np.sqrt(5)))*shock).shift(1)
print('dates',len(fac),'assets',len(assets),'overall_coverage %.4f'%fac.notna().mean().mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; vals=[];ns=[]; ds=[]
 for dt in fac.index:
  z=pd.concat([fac.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): vals.append(q);ns.append(len(z));ds.append(dt)
 x=np.array(vals); print('H',h,'dates',len(x),'avgN %.2f'%np.mean(ns),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f thirds'% (x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),np.mean(x>0)),[round(q.mean(),6) for q in np.array_split(x,3)])
 # recent 504 valid IC observations
 print(' recent504 IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f n %d'%(x[-504:].mean(),x[-504:].mean()/x[-504:].std(ddof=1),np.mean(x[-504:]>0),min(504,len(x))))
print('turnover',fac.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
out=[{'date':dt.date(),'asset':a,'signal':fac.loc[dt,a]} for dt in fac.index for a in assets]
pd.DataFrame(out).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330725_volshock_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2033-08-07'); P={}
for a in assets:
 d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date').loc[:cut]
 P[a]=d.close
P=pd.DataFrame(P); r=P.pct_change()
# Trend quality: signed 10d displacement divided by path length over 20d, lagged one day.
path=r.abs().rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()
fac=(P.pct_change(10)/path).shift(1)
print('cutoff',cut.date(),'dates',len(P),'assets',len(assets),'coverage %.4f'%fac.notna().mean().mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in fac.index:
  z=pd.concat([fac.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): vals.append(q);ns.append(len(z))
 x=np.array(vals)
 print('H%d dates %d avgN %.2f IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f thirds %s recent504 %.6f %.6f %.4f'%(
 h,len(x),np.mean(ns),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),np.mean(x>0),[round(q.mean(),6) for q in np.array_split(x,3)],x[-504:].mean(),x[-504:].mean()/x[-504:].std(ddof=1),np.mean(x[-504:]>0)))
print('turnover',fac.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
out=[{'date':dt.date(),'asset':a,'signal':fac.loc[dt,a]} for dt in fac.index for a in assets]
pd.DataFrame(out).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330808_recovery_efficiency_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cl={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s, days=5000)
    if d is not None and len(d): cl[s]=d.set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
p=pd.DataFrame(cl).sort_index()
r=p.pct_change()
# Relative acceleration: recent 10d return less prior 20d average daily return, lagged one day
recent=p.pct_change(10)
prior=p.pct_change(30).shift(10) # return over t-40..t-10
fac=(recent-prior/3.0).shift(1)
rows=[]
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
    fwd=p.shift(-h)/p-1
    vals=[]
    for dt in fac.index:
        x=fac.loc[dt]; y=fwd.loc[dt]
        z=pd.concat([x,y],axis=1).dropna()
        if len(z)>=8: vals.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1]))
    a=pd.Series(vals).dropna()
    print('H',h,'dates',len(a),'IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f'%(a.mean(),a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1), (a>0).mean()))
# coverage, turnover proxy and thirds at H10
x=fac; fwd=p.shift(-10)/p-1
ics=[]; ns=[]
for dt in x.index:
 z=pd.concat([x.loc[dt],fwd.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8: ics.append(z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1])); ns.append(len(z))
a=pd.Series(ics).dropna(); print('AVG_N',np.mean(ns),'MIN_N',min(ns),'coverage',x.notna().mean().mean())
print('thirds', [round(v,6) for v in np.array_split(a,3).copy().tolist() if False])
for q in np.array_split(a,3): print('third',q.mean())
# turnover ranks
rank=x.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',rank.diff().abs().mean().mean())

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2033-08-21'); P={}
for a in assets:
 d=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+a+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).sort_values('date').set_index('date').loc[:cut]
 P[a]=d.close
P=pd.DataFrame(P); r=P.pct_change()
# Recent acceleration versus preceding 30d trend, lagged one completed session.
fac=(P.pct_change(10)-P.pct_change(30).shift(10)/3.0).shift(1)
print('cutoff',cut.date(),'dates',len(P),'assets',len(assets),'coverage %.4f'%fac.notna().mean().mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in fac.index:
  z=pd.concat([fac.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): vals.append(q);ns.append(len(z))
 x=np.array(vals)
 print('H%d dates %d avgN %.2f minN %d IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f thirds %s recent504 %.6f %.6f %.4f'%(
 h,len(x),np.mean(ns),min(ns),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),np.mean(x>0),[round(q.mean(),6) for q in np.array_split(x,3)],x[-504:].mean(),x[-504:].mean()/x[-504:].std(ddof=1),np.mean(x[-504:]>0)))
print('turnover',fac.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean())
out=[{'date':dt.date(),'asset':a,'signal':fac.loc[dt,a]} for dt in fac.index for a in assets]
pd.DataFrame(out).to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330822_relative_acceleration_signal.csv',index=False)

assets=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

print('cutoff',cut.date(),'dates',len(P),'assets',len(assets),'coverage %.4f'%fac.notna().mean().mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 fw=P.shift(-h)/P-1; vals=[]; ns=[]
 for dt in fac.index:
  z=pd.concat([fac.loc[dt],fw.loc[dt]],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8:
   q=z.iloc[:,0].corr(z.iloc[:,1],method='spearman')
   if pd.notna(q): vals.append(q);ns.append(len(z))
 x=np.array(vals)
 print('H%d dates %d avgN %.2f minN %d IC %.6f ICIR %.6f hit %.4f thirds %s recent504 %.6f %.6f %.4f'%(
 h,len(x),np.mean(ns),min(ns),x.mean(),x.mean()/x.std(ddof=1),np.mean(x>0),[round(q.mean(),6) for q in np.array_split(x,3)],x[-504:].mean(),x[-504:].mean()/x[-504:].std(ddof=1),np.mean(x[-504:]>0)))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 x=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'); x.date=pd.to_datetime(x.date)
 D[s]=x.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill(); ret=px.pct_change()
# Lagged downside-adjusted medium-term trend: 20-session return divided by
# downside deviation over the preceding 40 sessions; all inputs end at t-1.
lag=px.shift(1); mom=lag.pct_change(20)
dr=ret.shift(1).where(ret.shift(1)<0,0.0).rolling(40).apply(lambda x: np.sqrt(np.mean(x*x)),raw=True)
f=(mom/dr).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('instruments',len(D),'dates',len(px),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 a=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2:a.append(z.x.corr(z.y));ns.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(a).dropna(); print('H',h,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),'hit',(q>0).mean(),'n',len(q),'avgN',np.mean(ns))
q=[]
for i in range(len(px)-10):
 z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+10]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2:q.append((px.index[i],z.x.corr(z.y)))
q=pd.Series(dict(q));print('thirds H10',*[q.iloc[j*len(q)//3:(j+1)*len(q)//3].mean() for j in range(3)])
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover',rank.diff().abs().mean().mean())

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 x=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv');x.date=pd.to_datetime(x.date);D[s]=x.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill(); r=px.pct_change(); lag=px.shift(1)
# Relative residual trend: lagged 40d asset return minus contemporaneous equal-weight
# benchmark return, normalized by trailing 40d idiosyncratic volatility.
m=lag.pct_change(40); bm=m.mean(axis=1); resid=m.sub(bm,axis=0)
vol=r.shift(1).rolling(40).std(); f=(resid/vol).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('instruments',len(D),'dates',len(px),'coverage',f.notna().mean().mean())
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 a=[];ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2:a.append(z.x.corr(z.y));ns.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(a).dropna();print('H',h,'IC',q.mean(),'ICIR',q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),'hit',(q>0).mean(),'n',len(q),'avgN',np.mean(ns))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover',rank.diff().abs().mean().mean())
f.index=f.index.astype(str);f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20330919_relative_residual_trend_signal.csv')

### Explored Factors

1. **Downside-adjusted medium-term trend**
   - Construction: lagged 20-session return divided by trailing 40-session downside deviation.
   - Motivation: reward persistent positive trends while penalizing assets with adverse downside volatility.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20330919_downside_adjusted_trend_signal.csv`
   - Universe: all 15 tradable instruments.

2. **Relative residual trend**
   - Construction: lagged 40-session asset return minus the equal-weight cross-asset benchmark return, divided by trailing 40-session volatility.
   - Motivation: isolate asset-specific relative strength and reduce common cross-asset market exposure.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20330919_relative_residual_trend_signal.csv`
   - Universe: all 15 tradable instruments.

### Validation Results

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv');p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date);D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill(); cutoff=pd.Timestamp('2033-10-02');px=px.loc[:cutoff]
r=px.pct_change(); lag=px.shift(1)
# Volatility-normalized short reversal, with all inputs lagged one completed session.
f=(-lag.pct_change(5)/r.shift(1).rolling(20).std()).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
print('dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'coverage',round(f.notna().mean().mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 vals=[];ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2: vals.append(z.x.corr(z.y));ns.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna();print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
# H10 thirds and rank turnover
vals=[]
for i in range(len(px)-10):
 z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+10]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2: vals.append(z.x.corr(z.y))
q=pd.Series(vals).dropna();print('H10 thirds',*[round(q.iloc[j*len(q)//3:(j+1)*len(q)//3].mean(),6) for j in range(3)])
print('rank_turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv');p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date);D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill().loc[:'2033-10-02']; r=px.pct_change(); lag=px.shift(1)
# Dispersion-scaled 3d reversal: stronger reversal when prior cross-sectional dispersion is high.
csdisp=r.shift(1).std(axis=1).rolling(20).mean(); f=(-lag.pct_change(3)).mul(csdisp,axis=0)
print('dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'coverage',round(f.notna().mean().mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 a=[];ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2:a.append(z.x.corr(z.y));ns.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(a).dropna();print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331003_dispersion_reversal_signal.csv')

   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20331003_dispersion_reversal_signal.csv`
   - Universe: all 15 tradable instruments.

3. **High-dispersion conditional reversal**
   - Construction: negative lagged 3-session return, activated only when lagged daily cross-sectional dispersion exceeds its 60-session median.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'); p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date); D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill().loc[:'2033-10-16']; r=px.pct_change()
# Market-neutral 5-session reversal: remove each day's common cross-asset move,
# then reverse the asset's lagged 5d residual return and scale by lagged idiosyncratic volatility.
csmean=r.mean(axis=1); resid=r.sub(csmean,axis=0)
vol=resid.shift(1).rolling(40,min_periods=20).std()
f=(-resid.shift(1).rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum()).div(vol.replace(0,np.nan))
# strictly lag signal by using only completed observations through t-1
print('cutoff','2033-10-16','dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'coverage',round(f.notna().mean().mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 a=[]; ns=[]; dates=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2:
   a.append(z.x.corr(z.y));ns.append(len(z));dates.append(px.index[i])
 q=pd.Series(a).dropna();
 print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
 if h==10:
  n=len(q); print('thirds',*[round(q.iloc[j*n//3:(j+1)*n//3].mean(),6) for j in range(3)])
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331017_residual_reversal_signal.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv');p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date);D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill().loc[:'2033-10-16']; r=px.pct_change()
# Agreement reversal: combine lagged 3d and 10d reversal only when both point in same direction.
a=-px.shift(1).pct_change(3); b=-px.shift(1).pct_change(10)
f=((a.rank(axis=1,pct=True)-.5)+(b.rank(axis=1,pct=True)-.5))/2
f=f.where(a.mul(b)>0)
print('cutoff','2033-10-16','dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'coverage',round(f.notna().mean().mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 vals=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2: vals.append(z.x.corr(z.y));ns.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna();print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('turnover',round(f.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))

### Explored Factors

1. **Market-neutral volatility-scaled residual reversal**
   - Construction: subtract the daily cross-asset mean return from each instrument’s return, sum the lagged five-session residual returns, reverse the sign, and divide by lagged 40-session residual volatility.
   - Motivation: isolate idiosyncratic reversal while reducing broad benchmark rebound effects.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20331017_residual_reversal_signal.csv`
   - Universe: all 15 tradable instruments.

2. **Multi-horizon agreement reversal**
   - Construction: combine cross-sectional ranks of lagged three-session and ten-session reversal signals, retaining observations only when both horizons agree in direction.
   - Motivation: improve signal reliability by requiring reversal confirmation across short and medium horizons.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20331017_agreement_reversal_signal.csv`
   - Universe: all 15 tradable instruments.

### Validation Results

Validation cutoff: **2033-10-16**  
Historical sample: **4,280 dates**, 15 instruments. Cross-sectional IC observations required at least 8 valid instruments.

| Factor | Horizon | IC dates | Avg. N | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Coverage |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Residual volatility-scaled reversal | H1 | 4,257 | 15.00 | 0.006575 | 0.019320 | 50.53% | 99.48% |
|  | H5 | 4,253 | 15.00 | 0.006884 | 0.020155 | 50.91% | 99.48% |
|  | H10 | 4,248 | 15.00 | -0.001726 | -0.005000 | 49.88% | 99.48% |
|  | H20 | 4,238 | 15.00 | -0.001116 | -0.003281 | 51.13% | 99.48% |
| Multi-horizon agreement reversal | H1 | 2,941 | 10.06 | 0.019925 | 0.046158 | 51.96% | 59.25% |
|  | H5 | 3,032 | 10.06 | 0.012103 | 0.028053 | 51.72% | 59.25% |
|  | H10 | 3,029 | 10.06 | 0.005347 | 0.012502 | 49.42% | 59.25% |
|  | H20 | 3,024 | 10.06 | -0.005305 | -0.012498 | 50.17% | 59.25% |

Turnover proxies were approximately **0.1563** for residual reversal and **0.1402** for agreement reversal.

The agreement reversal’s H1 IC exceeded the 0.0070 IC gate, but its ICIR of 0.0462 remained below the required 0.0840 threshold. The residual reversal failed both thresholds at the principal horizons. Neither factor met the joint benchmark admission criteria. Library correlation diagnostics were not computed.

### Persistence Actions

- **No factors persisted.**
- Both candidates failed the required joint admission gate:
  - absolute IC ≥ **0.0070**
  - absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840**
- Signal artifacts were retained for research traceability.
- No live-account, backtest, step, date, or account operations were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

No new effective factors were added in this cycle. Existing effective library factors remain governed by their prior validation records.

### Plans

- Re-test agreement reversal with volatility normalization and broader coverage.
- Evaluate conditional agreement signals during high-dispersion or VIX-stress regimes.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'); p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date); D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill().loc[:'2033-10-30']; r=px.pct_change()
# High-dispersion shock reversal: reverse 5-session lagged returns, gated by

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'); p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date); D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill().loc[:'2033-11-13']; r=px.pct_change()
# Asymmetric recovery: after a broad negative cross-asset shock, reverse each
# asset's lagged 5-session return; activation uses only prior-day information.
csmean=r.mean(axis=1); disp=r.std(axis=1)
shock=(csmean.shift(1)<0)&(disp.shift(1)>disp.shift(1).rolling(60,min_periods=30).median())
raw=-px.shift(1).pct_change(5)
f=raw.where(shock,np.nan).rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('cutoff','2033-11-13','dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'coverage',round(f.notna().mean().mean(),4),'activation',round(shock.mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 vals=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2: vals.append(z.x.corr(z.y)); ns.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('turnover',round(f.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331114_negative_shock_recovery_signal.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'); p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date); D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill().loc[:'2033-11-13']; r=px.pct_change(); m=r.mean(axis=1)
disp=r.std(axis=1); shock=(m.shift(1)<0)&(disp.shift(1)>disp.shift(1).rolling(60,min_periods=30).median())
# Lagged 5d asset return residualized to the common cross-asset 5d move.
r5=px.pct_change(5); m5=m.rolling(5).sum(); beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=30).cov(m).div(m.rolling(60,min_periods=30).var(),axis=0)
resid=r5-beta.mul(m5,axis=0); raw=-resid.shift(1); f=raw.where(shock,np.nan).rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('cutoff','2033-11-13','dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'coverage',round(f.notna().mean().mean(),4),'activation',round(shock.mean(),4))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 vals=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2: vals.append(z.x.corr(z.y)); ns.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('turnover',round(f.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6)); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331114_negative_shock_residual_reversal_signal.csv')

   - Construction: reverse each instrument’s lagged 5-session return after a prior-day regime with negative average cross-asset return and above-median 60-session cross-sectional dispersion.

   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20331114_negative_shock_recovery_signal.csv`

   - Construction: same negative/high-dispersion activation condition, but reverse 5-session asset returns after residualizing against the common cross-asset return using rolling 60-session beta.
   - Motivation: isolate idiosyncratic recovery effects and reduce exposure to broad market rebound.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20331114_negative_shock_residual_reversal_signal.csv`
   - Coverage: **23.00%** overall; activation rate **23.02%**.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'); p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date); D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill().loc[:'2033-11-27']; r=px.pct_change()
# Continuous severity: prior-day broad negative return, scaled by its own 60d
# volatility, and cross-sectional dispersion. Signal is lagged 5d reversal
# multiplied by bounded shock severity; all inputs are known at decision date.
mu=r.mean(axis=1); disp=r.std(axis=1)
muvol=mu.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std(); dv=disp.rolling(60,min_periods=30).median()
severity=(-mu.shift(1)/muvol.shift(1)).clip(lower=0,upper=3) * (disp.shift(1)/dv.shift(1)).clip(lower=0.5,upper=2)
active=(mu.shift(1)<0)&severity.notna()
raw=-px.shift(1).pct_change(5)
f=raw.mul(severity,axis=0).where(active,np.nan).rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('cutoff','2033-11-27','dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'coverage',round(f.notna().mean().mean(),4),'activation',round(active.mean(),4),'active_dates',int(active.sum()))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 vals=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2: vals.append(z.x.corr(z.y)); ns.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('turnover',round(f.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331128_continuous_shock_recovery_signal.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv');p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date);D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill().loc[:'2033-11-27']; r=px.pct_change(); mu=r.mean(1); disp=r.std(1)
# delayed post-shock reversal: shock observed 3 sessions ago, enter only after
# immediate rebound/noise has passed; factor uses return ending yesterday.
shock=(mu.shift(3)<0)&(disp.shift(3)>disp.shift(3).rolling(60,min_periods=30).median())
raw=-px.shift(1).pct_change(5)
f=raw.where(shock,np.nan).rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('cutoff 2033-11-27 dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'coverage',round(f.notna().mean().mean(),4),'activation',round(shock.mean(),4),'active_dates',int(shock.sum()))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 v=[];n=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2:v.append(z.x.corr(z.y));n.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(v).dropna();print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(n),2),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('turnover',round(f.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6));f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331128_delayed_shock_recovery_signal.csv')

### Explored Factors

1. **Continuous-severity shock recovery reversal**
   - Construction: after a broad negative cross-asset session, reverse each instrument’s lagged 5-session return.
   - Shock severity is scaled by:
     - broad-market return relative to rolling 60-session volatility, and
     - cross-sectional dispersion relative to its rolling median.
   - Severity is bounded to reduce outlier influence.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20331128_continuous_shock_recovery_signal.csv`

2. **Delayed shock recovery reversal**
   - Construction: apply the same 5-session reversal signal three sessions after a negative/high-dispersion shock.
   - Motivation: avoid immediate rebound noise and test delayed recovery effects.
   - Universe: all 15 tradable benchmark instruments.
   - Signal artifact: `scripts/miner_2_20331128_delayed_shock_recovery_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

Validation cutoff: **2033-11-27**. Each active cross-section contained all 15 instruments. Admission gates were absolute IC ≥ **0.0070** and absolute ICIR ≥ **0.0840**.

| Factor | Horizon | IC dates | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Coverage | Turnover |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Continuous-severity shock recovery | H1 | 2,005 | 0.018909 | 0.051685 | 51.52% | 46.54% | 0.147007 |
|  | H5 | 2,003 | 0.022693 | 0.063809 | 52.87% |  |  |
|  | H10 | 2,003 | 0.014351 | 0.039916 | 51.37% |  |  |
|  | H20 | 1,998 | 0.017305 | 0.048596 | 51.75% |  |  |
| Delayed shock recovery | H1 | 990 | 0.013255 | 0.035857 | 51.11% | 22.97% | 0.126569 |
|  | H5 | 990 | 0.013025 | 0.035616 | 50.91% |  |  |
|  | H10 | 990 | 0.005946 | 0.015908 | 50.71% |  |  |
|  | H20 | 988 | 0.013408 | 0.036974 | 52.63% |  |  |

The continuous-severity variant improved coverage and maintained positive IC across horizons, but its best ICIR, **0.063809 at H5**, remained below the **0.0840** threshold. The delayed variant was weaker and also failed the IC gate at H10.

`max_abs_library_correlation` was not computed because neither candidate passed admission and no library-comparison artifact was available.

### Persistence Actions

- **No factors persisted.**
- Both candidates failed the joint IC/ICIR admission criteria.
- Signal artifacts were retained for research traceability.
- No live-account, backtest, step, date, or account operations were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

No new factors were added. Existing effective factors remain governed by their prior validation records, including the previously persisted downside-risk-adjusted medium-momentum factor:

- `factors/miner_2_20330418_downside_momentum.json`
- Latest recorded validation: **2033-04-17**
- H10 IC: **-0.056245**
- H10 ICIR: **-0.194073**
- Direction: inverse

### Plans

- Test shock severity based on cross-sectional return breadth and tail quantiles rather than dispersion alone.
- Explore asset-class-specific recovery signals, particularly whether rebounds are stronger in defensive assets or high-beta assets.
- Test residual recovery with nonlinear severity weighting and shorter reversal windows.
- Continue monitoring factor overlap with existing reversal and defensive-trend factors before any persistence decision.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'); p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date); D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill().loc[:'2033-12-11']; r=px.pct_change()
# Breadth-tail shock recovery: after a broad negative session, reverse each asset's
# five-session return relative to the cross-sectional mean; weight by continuous
# negative breadth and tail intensity. All signal inputs are lagged one session.
csmean=r.mean(axis=1); breadth=(r<0).mean(axis=1)
vol=csmean.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std(); tail=(-csmean.shift(1)/vol.shift(1)).clip(0,3)
# require broad selloff, with a smooth breadth score; avoid binary sparse activation
bscore=((breadth.shift(1)-0.50)/0.50).clip(0,1)
active=(breadth.shift(1)>=0.60)&tail.notna()
raw=-(px.shift(1).pct_change(5).sub(px.shift(1).pct_change(5).mean(axis=1),axis=0))
f=raw.mul((0.25+0.75*bscore)*tail,axis=0).where(active,np.nan).rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('cutoff','2033-12-11','dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'coverage',round(f.notna().mean().mean(),4),'activation',round(active.mean(),4),'active_dates',int(active.sum()))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 vals=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2: vals.append(z.x.corr(z.y)); ns.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('turnover',round(f.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331212_breadth_tail_residual_recovery_signal.csv')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
D={}
for s in U:
 p=pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv'); p.date=pd.to_datetime(p.date); D[s]=p.set_index('date').close.astype(float)
px=pd.DataFrame(D).sort_index().ffill().loc[:'2033-12-25']; r=px.pct_change()
csmean=r.mean(axis=1); breadth=(r<0).mean(axis=1); vol=csmean.rolling(60,min_periods=30).std()
tail=(-csmean.shift(1)/vol.shift(1)).clip(0,3)
bscore=((breadth.shift(1)-0.50)/0.50).clip(0,1)
active=(breadth.shift(1)>=0.55)&tail.notna()
raw=-(px.shift(1).pct_change(5).sub(px.shift(1).pct_change(5).mean(axis=1),axis=0))
f=raw.mul((0.25+0.75*bscore)*tail,axis=0).where(active,np.nan).rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('cutoff 2033-12-25 dates',len(px),'instruments',len(U),'coverage',round(f.notna().mean().mean(),4),'activation',round(active.mean(),4),'active_dates',int(active.sum()))
for h in [1,5,10,20]:
 vals=[]; ns=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  z=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('x'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.x.nunique()>2: vals.append(z.x.corr(z.y)); ns.append(len(z))
 q=pd.Series(vals).dropna(); print('H',h,'dates',len(q),'avgN',round(np.mean(ns),2),'IC',round(q.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(q.mean()/q.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round((q>0).mean(),4))
print('turnover',round(f.diff().abs().mean().mean(),6)); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_2_20331226_breadth_tail55_signal.csv')
